response.details: The run slot is one per Group. Any work token of this Group (new, edit, review) reads the summary of the run holding it through group_read / group_list (another Group's run answers 404). Read only: only the owning TR's edit token or the owning draft token cancels it. A cancel response's cancel field tells the request being accepted apart from the run being confirmed stopped.

errors.details: Check the group of the requested run_id.
